title: Model 100 Numeric Processing
versionOrder: Within each capture, save order is retained. Cross-capture ordering is a presentation guess; tape numbers do not establish development dates. Similarity clusters are provisional, and collected saves are not necessarily revisions of one program.

versions.label: Cassette name L
versions.note: validated payload; runtime untested. Model 100 header/body framing and additive checksum; declared payload length; strictly increasing records; one consistent pointer base; exact record coverage of payload; exact left/right bytes
versions.unavailableReason: Incomplete, uncertain, or nonstandard captured payload; see the recovery validation. This format or machine is not supported by the shared stock Level II BASIC player. The source refers to extensions, external cassette data, machine code, or functions unavailable in the stock player.
versions.startupSource:
5 DEFDBL L:DEFINT A-K,M-Z
10 SZ=31
20 DIM L(100,2),TB(3,SZ)
30 G=0
40 P=20
45 BL=P
50 READ LS
51 MF=2
60 IF LS=-999 THEN 100 :ELSE IF LS<0 THEN P=P+(-LS)+1 :ELSE P=P+1:L(P,G)=LS:BH=P
70 GOTO 50
100 NL=BH+2:NH=BL-2
110 FOR P=BL-1 TO BH+1
